facts.text: I laugh because dinner is funny. I do not laugh because I am happy. Pass the bread.
facts.why: Drax laughs from real amusement in the film, and Mantis shares it ('I have never felt such humor!'). The line is invented and runs against that. The card also prints it under 'From the host', but Ego is the host.
facts.fix: Humility. I like it. I, too, am extraordinarily humble.

facts.text: I. Baby Groot dancing with a bomb.
facts.why: Baby Groot dances during the opening fight and later plants Rocket's bomb on Ego's brain, but no source shows him dancing with the bomb.
facts.fix: Baby Groot dancing through the opening fight

facts.text: The Ravagers' snowy hangout on Contraxia.
facts.why: Contraxia is described as a 'pleasure planet', with the Iron Lotus establishment. Nothing opened says it is snowy.
facts.fix: The Iron Lotus on the pleasure planet Contraxia.
